title: TreasuryAccount (internal capital account)
description: One internal capital account. INVARIANT: one account holds ONE asset - a multi-asset balance is several accounts, so every movement names the asset it moves. `owner_kind` is a closed set because an unlisted owner kind would make internal capital unauditable. A balance that is not reported means UNKNOWN, not zero: a movement must refuse to touch an account whose balance is unknown rather than inventing a starting balance.

asset.description: The single asset this account holds. Kept as the Go symbol string because no asset_id producer exists yet; asset_id is listed alongside for the migration.
